title: 新船造价高企：航运CEO却说市场平衡，船队更新需求能否支撑？
speaker: Martin Fluegaard

segments.en: Talk to us about the, you know, when you talk about this balance, the freight market looks quite tight, new bills are also quite pricey, how are you looking at things going forward in terms of freight, fleet renewal, I should say.
segments.zh: 谈谈这种平衡，运费市场紧张，新船价格高，你们如何看待未来的运费和船队更新？

segments.en: The view we have already is that asset values are high, so it's actually very expensive, at least historically it's expensive to buy the ship, so in that sense we are a little bit careful and that's why we like the optionality instead of the full commitment to it, the yards are full, if you want to buy a ship today, you probably get delivered in 2030,
segments.zh: 我们认为资产价值高，买船很贵，所以比较谨慎，喜欢期权而非全承诺。船厂排满，现在买船可能2030年交付。

segments.en: looking at the profile of the fleet today, there's an order book in our segment, around 12% of the fleet is on order, but ships above 20 years is above about 14%, that's quite balanced actually,
segments.zh: 看当前船队结构，我们板块的订单占船队约12%，而20年以上船龄占14%，相当平衡。

segments.en: and there is actually the last hike we had in the market in 2009 to 12th, one third of the fleet is built at that time, in 2029 they will become 20 years old, when ships become 20 years older become a little bit more difficult to trade their small fuel inefficient and so on.
segments.zh: 2009-2012年市场高峰时建造的船占三分之一，到2029年将满20年，老旧船交易困难且燃油效率低。

segments.en: So actually when you look at the balance of things even though asset values are high, it looks quite balanced actually going forward.
segments.zh: 所以尽管资产价值高，但供需平衡，未来看起来相当均衡。
